scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && (npm run dev --workspace backend & npm run dev --workspace frontend)
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/shared && npm run prisma:generate && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run test --workspace packages/shared && npm run test --workspace backend --if-present && npm run test --workspace frontend --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace packages/shared && npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
